evidence.source: 普及版 字通, via Kotobank
evidence.field: 右 字形 / 形聲與語義說明
evidence.text: The dictionary analyzes 又 as a right hand and 口 as a ritual prayer vessel, interpreting the combination in a ritual context. It rejects the Shuowen/Duan hand-and-mouth account as the graph's actual formation. It says oracle-bone forms using 又 could express divine assistance and describes later bronze uses meaning assistance. This supports a competing scholarly account, but does not prove that 口 was a meaningless differentiating mark.
evidence.title: 右(ウ)とは？ 意味や使い方 - コトバンク

evidence.field: 說文釋形 / 釋義 / 形體資料表
evidence.text: The Ministry of Education entry preserves two Shuowen forms: “助也。从口，从又” and “手口相助也。从又，从口,” and records assistance, favoring, reverence, direction, west, and rank senses. It lists oracle-bone and bronze paleographic collections in its form table but marks their source illustrations unavailable in the public view. The Shuowen text and its received component-order differences document the textual tradition; they do not establish the original formation or a dated semantic sequence.
evidence.title: A00483 右 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.field: 字源字形 / inscription catalog / 說文校注
evidence.text: The page catalogs an oracle-bone specimen as 鐵7.4 合20836, early Western Zhou bronzes including 右作旅鼎, 小盂鼎, 班簋, 夨令方彝 and 師旂鼎, then Chu manuscripts, Qin slips, Shuowen seal, and clerical forms. It also records variant Shuowen wording and commentary disputing the received hand-and-mouth account. The page does not date the oracle specimen or independently establish the transition sequence; its cataloged witnesses therefore do not fix the earliest sense.
evidence.title: 右 yòu - 汉典

evidence.source: Kotobank, 精選版 日本国語大辞典
evidence.text: The entry dates a documentary ‘above/previously stated’ use of 右 to a late-eighth-century 万葉集 note, 右方 in a contest to 898, and directional 右 to 栄花物語, circa 1028–1092. These are dates for Japanese textual examples, not for the Chinese graph's first appearance or earliest sense.
evidence.title: 右(ウ)とは？ 意味や使い方 - コトバンク

evidence.text: The page separately records right for assistance (citing Shuowen and classical texts), blessing or protection, right hand and side, west, rank, and banquet-related ‘urge food’ usage glossed as 侑. The classical citations are not independently dated first attestations here; their list cannot establish a chronology or a semantic link among direction, ritual service, help, and blessing.
evidence.title: 右 yòu - 汉典

evidence.text: The exact description page for 右-bigseal.svg identifies a vector depiction in Liushutong script style, says source material includes Sinica Database, Chinese Etymology, and other databases, and declares the SVG public domain. This is a modern digital redraw, not a photograph or facsimile of an ancient artifact. Its script-style label does not itself date the depicted form to an excavated specimen.

search_audit.query: 右 甲骨文 金文 字形演变 字源 右 字通 又 口 祭祀; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E5%8F%B3-seal.svg 右 seal svg; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E5%8F%B3-bronze.svg 右 bronze svg; 右 甲骨文 助也 用例 甲骨 金文 方位 右手
search_audit.outcome: Opened Kotobank, ZDIC, and the Taiwan Ministry of Education dictionary entry. An additional searchable paleography account summarized the 又-plus-口 differentiator theory, but direct opening failed with a Unicode decoding error. Exact old candidate Commons URLs for 右-seal.svg and 右-bronze.svg were inaccessible.

Search found exact Commons description pages and category pages. The oracle file has been excluded because its original direct image URL is listed as a failed acquisition candidate. The big-seal page was inspected in search results as a permitted alternate; its direct original URL is derived from that exact page.
Queries did not surface a usable exact right-bronze or right-seal description page. Unrelated results were not selected.
Search indexing exposed exact alternate Commons character pages and file details. Selected only the inspected big-seal page, not the failed oracle candidate.

gaps: No directly opened primary paleographic corpus image or dated original inscription was inspected. The precise graphic transition and the first attestations of directional, assisting, or blessing uses remain undetermined.

The Shuowen material has variant component ordering and a disputed hand-and-mouth explanation; the opened references do not include a critical manuscript witness to resolve possible textual corruption.
The sources do not establish that 口 was only a meaningless differentiating addition, nor that it necessarily depicts a prayer vessel. The rival analyses remain interpretations.

ZDIC and Kotobank list semantic uses and classical citations, but do not establish the earliest Chinese sense or a chronological chain connecting direction, ritual service, assistance, blessing, rank, and banquet use.
Xiaoxuetang's character query was unavailable with HTTP 401 in the supplied query record. The local candidate image files were leads only and were not used as provenance evidence.

Both official Unicode character-specific pages for 右 (U+53F3) and 又 (U+53C8) failed to open in this invocation. Supplied local kMandarin rows report yòu for each, but those local values are not independently authenticated as external evidence here.

The supplied local Baxter–Sagart rows give 又: MC hjuwH, OC *[ɢ]ʷəʔ-s, ‘also, in addition’; and 右: MC hjuwX, OC *[ɢ]ʷəʔ, ‘right hand’, plus MC hjuwH, OC *[ɢ]ʷəʔ-s (~ *m-qʷəʔ), ‘right hand’. They are local table readings, not proof of a phonetic role. The Baxter–Sagart source PDF was inaccessible in the dossier research, and no new exact table page was verified here.
No source independently establishes 又 as a phonetic component of 右. Evidence that 又 was used as a whole graph for other words must not be conflated with a component's phonetic role.
No reuse terms for repeated dictionary datasets or bulk extracts were verified; a tracked extract is not recommended.

The alternate selected Commons image is a modern vector rendering of a named script style; it does not provide an ancient artifact image. The separate local image acquisition step must verify the derived direct URL.
